title: 5Star Loft at WeHo / Downtown Nashville
description:
Make Nashville your fall landing spot! Just 5 minutes from Broadway, this stylish home offers off-street parking for 4, a comfy bed, sleeper sofa, spotless kitchen, modern finishes & in-unit washer/dryer. Perfect for work assignments, with Dudley Park, local breweries & WeHo Farmers Market nearby. Open to mid-term, insurance & temporary housing stays. Special pricing available for insurance & temporary housing guests!

The space
Bliss Road Offers 5 Star Properties,
Fully Furnished with all Amenities,
High End Towels/Linens/ and Bedding.

Every home has a starter kit stocked with paper products, including paper towels and toilet paper, as well as coffee supplies!

Guest access
Guests can enjoy whole house. It is reserved for paid overnight guests only.

Other things to note
**Traveling with pets? We’re happy to welcome your furry friends! 

Please note there is a pet fee of $250 per pet, with a maximum of 2 pets per stay. This fee will be charged as your reservation is confirmed. 

Let us know in advance if you’ll be bringing a pet so we can ensure everything is ready for a comfortable stay, for both you and your companions!**
